Fusion base curves were copied from FICO grade G on 2026-10-28.

Fusion loans: cash-flow-underwritten student loans for thin-file borrowers at schools with internal payment plans. Investor pays the school an advance (A% of face) at month 0 + upfront fees; across-life fees (Goal servicing) come off the top of collections; remaining net collections split investor / school by tiered targets (MOIC or IRR), tested per term within each monthly vintage.

F1 inputs → F2 per-$1 engine by term (24/36/48/60m) + blended → F2a gross (pre-fee) vs net asset returns → F3 pool (stacks monthly vintages, other SPV fees, leverage, recycling) → F4 SPV (OCM / Loan America capital split + promote waterfall, returns) → F5 dashboard.

Grade G curves: 24m & 36m use the short curve, 48m & 60m the long curve, each stopped at its own term (24m sits on the short curve to month 24; 48m on the long curve to 48). Loss & prepay multipliers, recoveries + lag, payment stop (FICO method).

b: BUILT and verified (Steps 1-5 done 2026-10-21; extended 2026-10-22/28). v4 is Fusion-only. See sections 2-7 for the current state; the rows below are the original agreed spec, kept for reference.
Student loans to thin-file borrowers underwritten on CASH FLOW (not FICO), offered through schools that run INTERNAL PAYMENT PLANS. Money is disbursed to the school (tuition etc.).
ALL NEW TABS (prefix 'Fusion'). Existing FICO model must stay untouched.
Investor = OCM + Loan America (SPV). Originator = Loan America. Servicer = Goal (third party). Counterparty = the School.
Use Tier G curves only. 24m & 36m use G SHORT (36m) curve; 24m sits on the 36m curve and stops at month 24. 48m & 60m use G LONG (60m) curve; 48m sits on the 60m curve and stops at month 48.
Same rule as losses: G SHORT SMM for 24/36 (24 capped at 24), G LONG SMM for 48/60 (48 capped at 48).
Biggest change vs traditional loans: investor pays only A% of face (e.g. 25¢ or 30¢ per $1) — INPUT, flexible.
Purchase price (A% x face) paid by investor → goes to the SCHOOL at month 0 (school gets A% of tuition upfront instead of waiting for plan collections).

FEE TABLE (2026-10-21): up to 10 fees, each ON/OFF. Type Upfront (paid by investor at month 0, part of outlay; % of Net paid or Face, or Fixed $ per loan) or Across life (OFF THE TOP of collections before investor/school split; % of monthly Collections, or annual % of Beginning/Ending/Average balance charged /12, or Fixed $ per active loan per month; applies for the whole life of the loan — no start/end months). Fixed $ per loan converted via average loan size B133. Prefilled: Origination – Loan America upfront 3% of net paid; Servicing – Goal across life 3% of collections.
SWITCH: (a) Fixed $ commitment for Loan America (e.g. $2.5M, OCM funds the rest) OR (b) % basis: OCM % input, Loan America % = 1 − OCM % (allow 100% OCM).
Must be available with ON/OFF switch and its own inputs (LTV, spread, ineligibles, cap, raise month, draw period, sweep) — same mechanics as current SPV.
Must be available with ON/OFF switch (collections fund new purchases during reinvestment period).
Model first at single-loan (asset) level, then scale to the full program/pool and SPV — mirror current flow: Assumptions → Unit Economics → Pool Cash Flows → SPV Summary (+ vintage view).
Same loan engine as Unit Economics: interest, scheduled principal, prepayments, charge-offs, payment-stop missed payments, recoveries (rate + lag) — all on G curves.

SUPERSEDED by fee table (see Origination fee row). Paid first, off gross collections. SWITCH for basis: (1) x% of monthly collections, (2) x% of BEGINNING balance, (3) x% of ENDING balance, (4) x% of AVERAGE (beg+end)/2 balance. Balances net of losses, prepays, recoveries. Balance-based rates assumed annual ÷12 (to confirm).
After servicing: Investor gets fixed % / School gets 100% − %, until Target 1 is hit. Target MODE switch: IRR or MOIC.

Flexible table of targets (Target 1, 2, 3, …) each with its own investor/school split; next split applies after previous target is hit. After last target: option 'continue previous split to end of term'; if OFF → 100% to school. FLEXIBLE TIERS (2026-10-21): target table with up to 10 tier rows; each row = ON/OFF flag + investor % + target (IRR or MOIC). Add a tier = fill a row & set ON; delete = set OFF or clear. Formulas skip OFF/blank rows and use active tiers in order; checks flag targets out of ascending order or splits outside 0-100%. Placeholder targets are illustrative only — user to supply real tiers. MECHANICS: MOIC mode = remaining need = target x outlay - cumulative investor cash. IRR mode = hurdle balance grows monthly at (1+target)^(1/12)-1 less investor cash; target hit when balance <= 0. Crossing month: cash needed at old split = need / old investor %, remainder of that month split at next tier (no overshoot). Each tier tested on TOTAL investor cash since month 0. VISUALS: per $1 views show rows Active tier, Investor%/School% in force, remaining need, running MOIC/IRR vs target, 'Tier n hit' flag; conditional-format colour band per tier, bold border on crossing month; stacked investor/school chart with running MOIC/IRR line vs targets; tier summary box (month hit, months in tier, $ to each party, IRR/MOIC at hit). USER TIERS (2026-10-21): Tier 1 60/40 until 1.5x MOIC; Tier 2 50/50 until 2.0x MOIC; continue 50/50 to end of term.

Investor share split between OCM and Loan America via a PROMOTE WATERFALL with editable hurdles (IRR) and OCM/LA splits per tier, mirroring current SPV (ROC pro rata → pref pro rata → promote tiers → residual). SWITCH: Promote ON / OFF (OFF = pure pro rata by capital). Promote can apply even at 100% OCM capital if switched on.

Monthly: investor collections, school collections; IRR and cumulative MOIC evolution by month for every entity (OCM, Loan America, total investor, school). Summary: investor outlay, collected, month each target hit, IRR, MOIC; school day-0 receipt, total collected, total as % of face (effective advance rate). SCHOOL PV PURPOSE (2026-10-21): not a comparison vs the school's own plan — it answers 'future cash is worth less today'. Effective advance rate (PV) = month-0 upfront + PV of school's share of collections at the inflation rate (FA B103); also show undiscounted effective advance rate.

Before scaling: show per $1 of face AND per term (24/36/48/60) AND blended mix — monthly running (cumulative) IRR and MOIC for investor, school (and OCM/LA), the month each target is hit, the split in force each month, and final IRR/MOIC/collections per target tier and in total.
Input discount rate (inflation) → PV of all school cash flows (incl. day 0) to today, and PV as % of face.
